title: 一碗面的清晨
logline: 写实竖屏短片记录清晨面馆后厨制作热面的全过程，传递一天从一碗面开始的生活仪式感。

shots.narrationEn: Early morning dough kneading brings the first hint of kitchen warmth.
shots.visual: In a quiet dawn noodle shop kitchen, the owner kneads smooth dough on a floured wooden countertop.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉静舒缓带暖意，语速偏慢，气息平稳，“揉面”处重读，传递踏实安稳的清晨氛围感

shots.narrationEn: Boiling water churns as steam rises from the cooking pot.
shots.visual: Freshly stretched noodles are dropped into a rolling pot of boiling water, with steam curling upwards.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪鲜活上扬，语速稍快，“沸水”“热气”重读，气息带跃动感，传递烟火升腾的鲜活劲儿

shots.narrationEn: A hot bowl of noodles marks the start of a brand new day.
shots.visual: The owner places a steaming hot bowl of noodles in front of the first guest by the sunlit shop window.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪温暖明亮，语速放缓，“一天”重读，尾音带轻缓笑意，传递治愈开启的满足感
